description.value: Walmart Supercentre is a large-format big-box store in Nelson, BC, offering a full grocery section alongside electronics, clothing, furniture, and baby products. For a touring cyclist passing through Nelson, it represents one of the most comprehensive resupply points in the region, with a broad product range under one roof. Nelson is a relatively remote Interior BC town, making this Supercentre an important provisioning stop on longer routes through the Kootenays.
